name: Lactic acid
notes: Non-sensitizer; official KeratinoSens proficiency-testing reference chemical; EC1.5 reference range >1000 uM

name: Cinnamyl alcohol
notes: Weak sensitizer per in vivo LLNA; KeratinoSens EC1.5 reference range 25-175 uM; SMILES without stereochemistry

name: Ethylene glycol dimethacrylate (EGDMA)
notes: Weak sensitizer per in vivo LLNA; KeratinoSens EC1.5 reference range 5-125 uM; also used as the assay's strong-induction quality-control compound (Annex 3)

name: Methyldibromo glutaronitrile (MDBGN)
notes: Strong sensitizer per in vivo LLNA; KeratinoSens EC1.5 reference range <20 uM; cosmetic preservative, banned in EU cosmetics since 2007

name: 4-Methylaminophenol (Metol)
notes: Strong sensitizer per in vivo LLNA; KeratinoSens EC1.5 reference range <12.5 uM; tested as the sulfate salt (CAS 55-55-0); SMILES shown is the free base; photographic developer chemical

name: 2,4-Dinitrochlorobenzene (DNCB)
notes: Extreme sensitizer per in vivo LLNA; KeratinoSens EC1.5 reference range <12.5 uM; classic strong LLNA/GPMT positive control
